# IIT Delhi: overview, contacts and student portals

**Address:** Indian Institute of Technology Delhi, Hauz Khas, New Delhi-110016, India.

title: IIT Delhi admissions: routes by programme
content:
# IIT Delhi admissions: routes by programme

## Undergraduate
The UG admissions page (https://academics.iitd.ac.in/ug-admissions/, updated 7 Jan 2026) covers entrants admitted through **JEE (Advanced) 2026, Preparatory 2025 and UCEED 2026** to B.Tech, B.Tech + M.Tech, B.Des and B.S. programmes. JEE (Advanced): https://jeeadv.iitd.ac.in/ (seat allocation for IITs is through JoSAA; confirm on that site).

## M.Tech and M.Sc
- M.Tech is through GATE with COAP offer rounds; the institute also runs a **SPOT round** for full-time M.Tech after all COAP rounds (https://academics.iitd.ac.in/pg-admissions/).
- GATE/JAM: https://gate.iitd.ac.in/
- MBA: https://dms.iitd.ac.in/admission-mba/

## PhD and MS(R), Semester II 2026-27
Apply at https://ecampus.iitd.ac.in/PGADM/login.
- National candidates: last date **29.10.2026, 4:00 p.m.**; correction window to 01.11.2026 (closed).
- Foreign nationals: closed 08.11.2026 (midnight).
- Hostel seats for full-time PG and PhD students are **not guaranteed**. Hostel queries: adhm@admin.iitd.ac.in, 011-26591784.

## PhD funding (as stated)
- Institute Assistantship: **Rs. 37,000/month + 27% HRA** for the first 2 years, then **Rs. 42,000/month + 27% HRA**.
- PMRF: **Rs 70,000/month** stipend and **Rs 2 lakh** annual contingency grant.

Joint PhD: UQ-IITD (https://uqiitd.org/) and IITD-NYCU (https://nycu.iitd.ac.in/).

## Admission contacts
- UG: arugs@admin.iitd.ac.in, +91-11-2659-1718
- PG: aracad@admin.iitd.ac.in, +91-11-2654-8511
- GATE: chrgate@admin.iitd.ac.in, +91-11-2659-1749/1750/6137

title: IIT Delhi academic calendar, exams, hostels and support (2026-27)
content:
# IIT Delhi academic calendar, exams, hostels and support (2026-27)

Calendars are at https://timetable.iitd.ac.in/calendar (the old academic-calendar.php link redirects there). Day-by-day dates are in the linked PDFs; open them for exact dates.

## Latest calendar entries (with 'Updated on')
- Academic Calendar for **Semester II, 2026-27** (11-11-2026), the current semester.
- Academic Calendar for Semester I, 2027-28 (10-11-2026).
- Semester I, 2026-27 (31-07-2026); first-year UG calendar for Semester I, 2026-27 (06-07-2026).

## Exams and classes
- Endsem exam schedule for PYL0001, MTL0001 and CML0001 (15-11-2026).
- Minor/major exam scheduling portal: https://exam.iitd.ac.in/
- First-year UG class schedule, Semester 2, 2026-27: https://web.iitd.ac.in/~tti/ttfirstyearsem2_202627.html

## Fees
Online fee payment: https://home.iitd.ac.in/icollect/epay/index.php. Hostel charges: https://bhm.iitd.ac.in/resources. No fee amounts were read; check those pages.

## Hostels
The hall-of-residence page (https://home.iitd.ac.in/hall-of-residence.php) says hostels house 'a little over half (50%)' of enrolled students ('12500+ as of July 2023'). UG rooms are non-air-conditioned; tenure limits per programme are on that page.

## Contacts

- Timetable queries only: tti@iitd.ac.in
- Hostel management (ADHM): adhm@admin.iitd.ac.in, 011-26591784
- Emergency helpline: 011-2659-1000 · Hospital: https://hospital.iitd.ac.in/
- Counselling: https://bsw.iitd.ac.in/counselling.php
